mapper.select: SELECT s.id,s.code,s.name,s.status,l.name AS location_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sop_task t JOIN sop_subproject sp ON sp.id=t.subproject_id WHERE sp.project_id=#{projectId} AND sp.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.status!=2 AND t.station_id=s.id) AS task_count FROM sop_project_station ps JOIN sop_station s ON s.id=ps.station_id LEFT JOIN sop_location l ON l.id=s.location_id AND l.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE ps.project_id=#{projectId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND s.status=0 AND (LOCATE(#{keyword},s.name)>0 OR LOCATE(#{keyword},s.code)>0) ORDER BY s.id
